item.subject: science
item.stem: In a school garden in Pune, students have a small pond with pondweed, tadpoles and small fish. One season, a gardener removes most of the pondweed from the pond. What is the most likely effect on this ecosystem over the next few weeks?

options.A: Only the pondweed is affected; the tadpoles and small fish remain unchanged
options.B: The tadpoles lose a food source and hiding place, so their numbers fall, and the small fish that eat tadpoles are then also affected
options.C: The small fish population increases because there is more open water
options.D: The tadpoles increase because there is no longer any competition for food
